name: AKFA (Akfa Group)
verdict: Akfa Group is the holding founded by Jahongir Artykkhodjaev, a private entrepreneur (Tashkent hokim 2018-2023 but the company is his, not the state's). Nothing found.
note: Shirt sponsor of Pakhtakor 2023-2025 (oldfootballshirts.com) and on the 2026 home shirt per Football Kit Archive (blocked to scripts). Podrobno.uz (24 Aug 2026) reported — unconfirmed by the club or Artykkhodjaev — that he had stopped financing the team.
